notes: The colophon names no scribe, patron, owner or king. It contains only the end-of-section colophons of the Vālmīkirāmāyaṇa and of the Rāmāyaṇatilaka commentary, plus a date. The commentator is not named here. The era is not stated. I read 'saṃvat 1847' as Vikrama Saṃvat because the year has four digits and is written in Devanagari with 'miti'. That gives CE 1790 (VS 1847 Mārgaśīrṣa ≈ Nov/Dec 1790). The year matches the catalogue field 'Samvat 1847'.
